race.comment: VOLTRIX (8) has the clearest race form, having been beaten a nose as favourite on debut at Geelong before keeping up to the mark with a close Flemington trial second. He was professional enough to track into the race and only just missed, any natural improvement sees him go close. BERARDO (2) is the most interesting debutant after a comfortable Caulfield Heath trial win, and the Blake Shinn-Mark Walker combination suggests he'll be ready to go. ACE STRIKE (1) was safely held first-up, but he began awkwardly at Sandown-Hillside, has trialled close-up since and is drawn to get every chance, look for improvement. SLUGGER (7) also arrives with trial substance, including a Cranbourne win, and the Price and Kent stable are worth respecting, especially at this track where they strike well.
